# Obscura — Style Reference

> Pixel-brick dungeon under a pale sky, one ember key. A condensed bitmap headline face and a quiet grotesk sit on #dceefe sky with no visible hairlines, and a single traffic-cone orange does every job that asks for attention.

**Theme:** light

Values are measured from the live site and normalized; names, roles and recommendations are interpretation. Font lists are independent, not paired by position. Example prompts describe reconstructions, not the site's source code.

Obscura speaks an arcade-on-SaaS language: a bitmap display face and pixel-art illustration laid over the soft component kit of a current product site. The canvas is Sky Canvas #dceefe. On it sit Frosted Glass #ffffff66 comparison panels, Paper #ffffff cards and nav, and a Graphite Ink #232629 promo panel, with the Umber Footer #6c3200 closing the page. The chromatic budget is one hue. Ember Signal #ff5e24 fills every CTA, colors the second line of each headline and outlines the Obscura side of the comparison, and Cinder Alert #f4352f is held back for connection status alone. Jersey 10 carries all hierarchy at 60 to 96px, with a fixed -0.025em track and line-heights under 0.85. Press Start 2P handles uppercase pixel banners, and Manrope at 500 to 700 does every body and UI job at 12 to 18px. That is a 5.3x jump from body to display, where a Perfect Fourth scale would climb in steps. Shapes are soft: 6px buttons, 12px cards, 24px panels. Shadows are long, faint, multi-layer stacks. The whole reads as a game cabinet bolted to a dashboard rather than a security vendor's brochure.

## Tokens — Colors

| Ember Signal | `#ff5e24` | `--color-ember-signal` | Fills every CTA, tints second headline lines, the Manage Account link and the Obscura comparison border, 38+ uses — the system's only working hue. Keep it off large background fields. |
| Sky Canvas | `#dceefe` | `--color-sky-canvas` | Body background behind the hero, app mockup, comparison and feature grid — a pale daylight sky that makes the pixel clouds read as weather rather than ornament. |
| Paper | `#ffffff` | `--color-paper` | Nav bar, identity log cards, feature cards and CTA label text, 33 background uses — the workhorse lifted tile against the blue canvas. |
| Fog Surface | `#f6f8f7` | `--color-fog-surface` | Status strip ground, light copy on Graphite Ink panels and pill tags, 25 text uses — a green-grey near-white that keeps inverted copy soft instead of glaring. |
| Frosted Glass | `#ffffff66` | `--color-frosted-glass` | Comparison panels under a 12px backdrop blur, opacity estimated — lets clouds drift behind content. Do not stack glass on glass or use it under body paragraphs. |
| Graphite Ink | `#232629` | `--color-graphite-ink` | Headlines, logo, card names and the promo text panel, 52 text uses — a warm near-black that keeps pixel letterforms crisp without pure-black harshness. |
| Slate Text | `#5c6066` | `--color-slate-text` | Body paragraphs, nav links, ghost buttons, 65 uses and the most frequent text color — every sentence a visitor actually reads sits one step below headline ink. |
| Pewter Caption | `#989ea4` | `--color-pewter-caption` | IP addresses, timestamps and country sublabels, 23 uses — the tertiary metadata voice. Do not set paragraphs in it, since it falls under 3:1 on Paper. |

| Peach Bevel | `#ffc7b280` | `--color-peach-bevel` | The top-left 4px inset highlight on Ember pixel buttons — the lit edge of the bevel. Decorative only, never text or fill. |
| Cinder Alert | `#f4352f` | `--color-cinder-alert` | Not-connected dot, its 4px halo and status label, 2 uses — status only. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color, because it means danger here. |

| Umber Footer | `#6c3200` | `--color-umber-footer` | Footer background under the pixel-earth scene, with 112px top padding — the ground beneath the sky. Do not use it for cards above the fold. |

## Tokens — Typography

### Jersey 10 — condensed bitmap display face that carries every headline · `--font-jersey-10`

- **Substitute:** Jersey 10 is free on Google Fonts, so use it directly at 400. The face ships one weight, which means the measured 500 renders at 400 and the stroke is single-pixel thin. Alternatives are Jersey 15 at 400 and Pixelify Sans at 500, the latter a touch heavier, so keep it at 500 rather than 600.
- **Weights:** 400, 500
- **Sizes:** 36px, 48px, 60px, 72px, 96px
- **Line height:** 0.7 (96px), 0.8 (60px), 0.85 (72px), 1.0 (48px), 1.11 (36px)
- **Letter spacing:** -2.4px at 96px, -1.8px at 72px, -1.5px at 60px, -1.5px at 48px, normal at 36px
- **Role:** This is the signature. A game-cartridge bitmap face sets the brand promise, so trust is argued through character rather than gravitas, and that is anti-convention for a VPN category dominated by geometric sans in navy. Tracking holds at exactly -0.025em from 60 to 96px. Most systems tighten display type progressively, so this flat track preserves the pixel grid's rhythm. Line-heights of 0.7 to 0.85 stack the two-line headlines into a solid block, with the Ember second line reading as a punchline.

### Press Start 2P — uppercase arcade banner face for promotional micro-moments · `--font-press-start-2p`

- **Substitute:** Press Start 2P is free on Google Fonts at 400. Alternatives are Silkscreen at 400, which draws slightly lighter and wider, so set it 1px larger, and Tiny5 at 400.
- **Weights:** 400
- **Sizes:** 12px, 28px
- **Line height:** 1.33, 1.35, 1.55
- **Letter spacing:** -0.18px at 12px, normal at 28px
- **Role:** This is the system outlier, used only 4 times, all uppercase and all inside the pixel promo banner. Its blocky 8x8 glyphs are louder than Jersey 10, so it is rationed to campaign copy and pixel buttons. It acts as an arcade marquee rather than a navigation voice.

### Manrope Variable — rounded grotesk that does all reading and every interaction · `--font-manrope`

- **Substitute:** Manrope is free on Google Fonts, so use it directly. It draws slightly light for its number, with open apertures. Alternatives are Plus Jakarta Sans at the same weights and Inter at one step lighter (600 for Manrope 700), because Inter's tighter forms read heavier.
- **Weights:** 400, 500, 600, 700, 800
- **Sizes:** 12px, 14px, 16px, 18px
- **Line height:** 1.33 (12px), 1.43 (14px), 1.5 (16px, 18px)
- **Letter spacing:** normal at all sizes
- **Role:** This is the workhorse, at 211 measured elements. Hierarchy inside body copy comes from weight, not size: 500 for paragraphs, 600 for buttons, 700 for bold inline phrases such as "can't log your activity". The body range is compressed into a 1.14 ratio, far flatter than a Major Third. That deliberately leaves all drama to Jersey 10 and keeps the interface voice calm and legible.

### Type Scale

| Role | Family | Weight | Size | Line Height | Letter Spacing | Token |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| small | Manrope Variable | 600 | 12px | 1.33 | 0px | `--text-small` |
| caption | Press Start 2P | 400 | 12px | 1.55 | -0.18px | `--text-caption` |
| body-sm | Manrope Variable | 500 | 14px | 1.43 | 0px | `--text-body-sm` |
| body | Manrope Variable | 500 | 16px | 1.5 | 0px | `--text-body` |
| body-lg | Manrope Variable | 700 | 18px | 1.5 | 0px | `--text-body-lg` |
| subheading | Press Start 2P | 400 | 28px | 1.35 | 0px | `--text-subheading` |
| heading-sm | Jersey 10 | 400 | 36px | 1.11 | 0px | `--text-heading-sm` |
| heading | Jersey 10 | 500 | 60px | 0.8 | -1.5px | `--text-heading` |
| heading-lg | Jersey 10 | 500 | 72px | 0.85 | -1.8px | `--text-heading-lg` |
| display | Jersey 10 | 500 | 96px | 0.7 | -2.4px | `--text-display` |

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Set every section headline in Jersey 10 at 60px with -1.5px tracking and 0.8 line-height — the bitmap face is the brand, and the tight leading turns two lines into one block.
- Put the claim of each headline in #ff5e24 and the setup in #232629 — the orange second line is how Obscura delivers a punchline.
- Keep all body and UI copy in Manrope Variable at 14 to 16px weight 500, in #5c6066 — calm reading text is what makes the pixel display read as intentional rather than gimmicky.
- Use #ff5e24 as the only fill on interactive elements, with shadow md and an 8px radius at 48px height — one orange object per viewport is non-negotiable.
- Separate surfaces with faint multi-layer shadows (subtle at 1–3% black, sm at 1–4% navy) instead of 1px grey borders — the sky canvas should flow uninterrupted behind white tiles.
- Contain pixel art inside rounded frames of 24px or 48px — game imagery is quarantined in soft cartridges, so the product UI keeps its credibility.
- Hold sections 96px apart on #dceefe with pixel clouds drifting in the gutters — whitespace on Obscura is sky, and the clouds give it scale.

### Don't

- Don't set body paragraphs or nav links in Jersey 10 or Press Start 2P at 14 to 16px — bitmap faces at text size collapse into noise, and the arcade-headline, grown-up-interface split is the whole thesis.
- Don't give the standard Ember Button a 0px radius to match the pixel art — square corners belong only to Pixel Buttons inside the 48px promo banner, and outside it they read as broken UI.
- Don't introduce a second accent such as #2473eb for links or icons — Cobalt Mark exists once, as the competitor's color, and any spread dilutes the one-hue budget.
- Don't use #f4352f for CTAs or sale badges — Cinder Alert means "not connected", and a red button would turn a privacy promise into a warning.
- Don't outline secondary buttons with a 1px #5c6066 border the way most SaaS kits do — Obscura demotes secondary actions to 600-weight text links, so Ember stays the single target.
- Don't loosen Jersey 10 line-height to a conventional 1.1 at 96px — at 0.7 the two lines lock together, and opening them up turns a headline into two captions.
- Don't place body copy in #989ea4 on #ffffff — Pewter Caption falls under 3:1 and should never carry more than an IP address or timestamp.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**
- canvas: #dceefe (Sky Canvas)
- card surface: #ffffff (Paper)
- headline text: #232629 (Graphite Ink)
- body text: #5c6066 (Slate Text)
- metadata text: #989ea4 (Pewter Caption)
- status: #f4352f (Cinder Alert)
- primary action: #ff5e24 (filled action)

**Color in Data**
Data views stay neutral (#ffffff tiles, #5c6066 and #989ea4 labels, fading opacity for depth), and #ff5e24 marks exactly one series or row — the Obscura side — as a 1px outline or text color rather than a solid bar fill, so the accent identifies rather than shouts.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Primary Action Button: Build an anchor reading "Try For Free" with a trailing 16px right-arrow icon and an 8px gap. Use background #ff5e24, text #ffffff, Manrope Variable 16px weight 600, line-height 24px, height 48px, padding 0 32px, border-radius 8px, no border. Apply box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.17), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.03), 0 0 0 1px #ff5e24, 0 1px 2px rgba(4,15,32,0.12), 0 4px 4px rgba(4,15,32,0.1), 0 8px 5px rgba(4,15,32,0.06), 0 15px 6px rgba(4,15,32,0.02). Center it below a headline with 32px top margin. For the nav variant, use height 36px, padding 8px 16px, 14px text, radius 6px, and the same shadow.

2. Hero section: On a #dceefe page, center a block at 1216px max-width with 96px top padding. Set an h1 in Jersey 10 at 96px weight 500, line-height 0.7, letter-spacing -2.4px. Line one, "Privacy that's", is #232629. Line two, "more than a promise", is #ff5e24. Below at 24px gap, add a Manrope Variable 16px weight 500 #5c6066 paragraph, max-width 672px, centered, with bold phrases at weight 700 #232629. Add the 48px Ember button 32px below. Under it at 24px gap, place two ghost links ("Use with Wireguard", "Other platforms") in Manrope 14px weight 600 #5c6066, each with a 16px icon, transparent background, padding 0 32px, radius 6px.

3. Navigation bar: Build a sticky bar 72px tall, background #ffffff, padding 0 64px, no border, box-shadow 0 5px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.03), 0 22px 22px rgba(0,0,0,0.03), 0 49px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.01), with inner content capped at 1216px. Left: a 103×22px wordmark in #232629, then links "Product", "Learn", "Pricing", "Discord" in Manrope 14px weight 500 #5c6066, padding 8px 16px, radius 6px, with chevrons on dropdowns. Right: "Manage Account" in 14px weight 600 #ff5e24, then the 36px Ember button with 6px radius. Above the bar, add a 32px #f6f8f7 strip with a centered 8px #f4352f dot (box-shadow 0 0 0 4px rgba(244,53,47,0.1)) and 12px weight 500 #f4352f text.

4. Glass comparison panel: Create two 496px columns with a 24px gap. Each panel has background #ffffff66, backdrop-filter blur(12px), border-radius 24px, padding 24px, and a 1px translucent white border, except the right panel, which takes a 1px #ff5e24 border. Each starts with a centered Manrope 16px weight 600 #232629 heading, with one key word in #2473eb on the left panel and #ff5e24 on the right. Inside, place a 16px-radius tile with a light grey fill and 8px padding containing white cards: background #ffffff, radius 12px, padding 16px, shadow 0 2px 4px rgba(15,34,52,0.04), 0 7px 7px rgba(15,34,52,0.04), 0 15px 9px rgba(15,34,52,0.02), 0 27px 11px rgba(15,34,52,0.01). Each card holds a 14px weight 600 #232629 name and a right-aligned 14px weight 500 #989ea4 IP. Cards fade to 50% opacity down the stack.

## Components

### Pill-Free Ember Button — Large (Primary)
**Role:** Hero and section primary action

Soft rectangle with a bevel. It takes background #ff5e24, text #ffffff, no border but a 1px #ff5e24 ring inside the md shadow, 8px radius, padding 0 32px, 48px height, Manrope Variable at 16px weight 600, with a trailing arrow icon and shadow md, meaning a 17% white top highlight over four stacked navy-tinted drops. The inset highlight gives the flat orange a lit, pressable top edge — it is the one physical-feeling object on the page, and it should appear at most twice per viewport.

### Compact Ember Button — Nav (Primary, Small)
**Role:** Persistent conversion in navigation

A scaled-down twin. It takes background #ff5e24, text #ffffff, 6px radius, padding 8px 16px, 36px height, Manrope Variable at 14px weight 600, with an arrow glyph and the identical shadow md. It is also used for in-section toggles such as "Show All". The radius drops from 8px to 6px as the height drops from 48px to 36px, so corner curvature stays proportional — use this size inside the 72px nav and dense UI, and the 48px version everywhere else.

### Ghost Text Button — Secondary
**Role:** Alternate platforms and quiet actions

Nearly invisible by design. It takes transparent background, text #5c6066, no border, no shadow, 6px radius at 40px height or 8px radius at 48px height, padding 0 32px, Manrope Variable at 14px or 16px weight 600, preceded by a 16px glyph icon. Secondary actions such as "Use with Wireguard" and "Other platforms" are demoted to captioned links rather than outlined buttons — anti-convention, which keeps Ember the single loud target under every headline.

### Pixel Button — Outline and Ember Variants
**Role:** Arcade CTAs inside promo banner

The deliberate system outlier. The outline variant takes transparent background over #232629, a 4px solid #ffffff border, text #ffffff. The Ember variant takes background #ff5e24 with shadow sm-2, a 4px #ffc7b280 top-left inset over a 4px #d54d1a bottom-right inset. Both take 0px radius, padding 12px 16px (estimated), 44px height (estimated), and Press Start 2P at 12px uppercase with -0.18px tracking. Square corners break the 6 to 48px soft vocabulary on purpose — they belong only inside pixel artwork, where a rounded button would look like a UI sticker.

### Navigation Bar
**Role:** Sticky top bar with conversion

A white shelf. It takes background #ffffff, 72px height, padding 0 64px, no border, shadow subtle, sticky positioning. The bitmap wordmark (103×22px, #232629) sits left, followed by links in Manrope Variable at 14px weight 500, #5c6066, padding 8px 16px, 6px radius, with chevrons on Product and Learn. Manage Account sits right at weight 600 in #ff5e24, beside the Compact Ember Button. The 49px-deep but 1%-opacity shadow lifts the bar off the sky without drawing a line — separation by atmosphere rather than a border.

### Connection Status Strip
**Role:** Live VPN state indicator

A diagnostic ribbon. It is a full-width 32px strip on #f6f8f7 above the nav, centered text in Manrope Variable at 12px weight 500 in #f4352f, led by an 8px Cinder Alert dot wrapped in shadow subtle-2, a 4px halo at 10% opacity. The strip reports the visitor's actual connection, so the page behaves like the product before any marketing copy loads — the only legitimate place for Cinder Alert.

### Pixel Promo Banner
**Role:** Campaign hero in game art

A dungeon diorama. It is a full-bleed pixel illustration (brick wall, caged robot, bones) clipped to a 48px radius at roughly 1180px wide. Overlaid is a #232629 text panel with 0px radius and 32px padding (estimated), holding a Press Start 2P 28px uppercase headline in #ffffff with the switch phrase in #ff5e24, Manrope Variable 16px weight 500 body in #ffffff, and two Pixel Buttons. The 48px radius is the largest in the system — it frames the artwork as a cartridge window, keeping game imagery quarantined inside a soft container.

### Display Headline Block
**Role:** Section opener and thesis

Two lines, one punchline. The first line is Jersey 10 at 96px weight 500, #232629, line-height 0.7, -2.4px tracking. The second line or closing phrase is set in #ff5e24. The block is centered, followed by a Manrope Variable 16px weight 500 #5c6066 paragraph at a 672px max-width, with weight 700 #232629 inline emphasis. Section variants step down to 60px with -1.5px tracking and 0.8 line-height. The orange half-line is the system's storytelling device — the second line always carries the claim.

### Glass Comparison Panel — Neutral and Obscura
**Role:** Side-by-side privacy proof

A frosted vitrine. It takes background #ffffff66 with 12px backdrop blur, 24px radius, 24px padding, 496px width. The neutral version has a 1px translucent white border. The Obscura version has a 1px #ff5e24 border, and its headline word sits in #ff5e24 against the competitor's single #2473eb word. Inside, 16px-radius grey tiles group the log cards. The orange border is the only place a hairline carries color — it marks the trustworthy column through outline, not fill.

### Identity Log Card
**Role:** Simulated surveillance record

A data receipt. It takes background #ffffff, no border, 12px radius, 16px padding, 412px width, shadow sm. The name sits in Manrope Variable 14px weight 600 #232629, the IP in 14px weight 500 #989ea4 right-aligned, and the detail rows (email, address, card) in 14px weight 400 #5c6066 with 16px icons. Stacked cards fade in opacity down the column. The navy-tinted four-layer shadow is warmer than the nav's grey stack, so content cards feel physically closer than chrome.

### Feature Card — Three-Up
**Role:** Benefit triplet

Centered and blunt. It takes background #ffffff, no border, 12px radius, 24px padding (estimated), no visible shadow, roughly 500px wide in a three-column row at 1536px. A 32px Ember pixel icon sits above a Manrope Variable 16px weight 700 #232629 question whose answer ("Not possible.") is set in #ff5e24, followed by 14px weight 500 #5c6066 body with weight 700 inline phrases. The question-answer split carries the headline device down into card scale — pair this card only with that pattern.

### Pill Tag — Exit IP
**Role:** Inline status label

A tiny capsule. It takes background #f6f8f7, text #989ea4, 9999px radius, padding 2px 8px, Manrope Variable at 12px weight 600, right-aligned inside Exit Node tiles reading "Obscura's IP". The fully rounded shape is reserved for these labels — pills mark metadata, never actions.

### Offset-Shadow Image Frame
**Role:** Founder and product imagery

A sticker on a desk. It takes a 712×534px image, 24px radius, no border, shadow xl, a hard 24px/24px offset at 7% black with zero blur. Hard offsets are how pixel art draws depth, and this is the one place the arcade shadow logic crosses into photographic content — use it for human or editorial images, not product UI.

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do

- Set every section headline in Jersey 10 at 60px with -1.5px tracking and 0.8 line-height — the bitmap face is the brand, and the tight leading turns two lines into one block.
- Put the claim of each headline in #ff5e24 and the setup in #232629 — the orange second line is how Obscura delivers a punchline.
- Keep all body and UI copy in Manrope Variable at 14 to 16px weight 500, in #5c6066 — calm reading text is what makes the pixel display read as intentional rather than gimmicky.
- Use #ff5e24 as the only fill on interactive elements, with shadow md and an 8px radius at 48px height — one orange object per viewport is non-negotiable.
- Separate surfaces with faint multi-layer shadows (subtle at 1–3% black, sm at 1–4% navy) instead of 1px grey borders — the sky canvas should flow uninterrupted behind white tiles.
- Contain pixel art inside rounded frames of 24px or 48px — game imagery is quarantined in soft cartridges, so the product UI keeps its credibility.
- Hold sections 96px apart on #dceefe with pixel clouds drifting in the gutters — whitespace on Obscura is sky, and the clouds give it scale.

### Don't

- Don't set body paragraphs or nav links in Jersey 10 or Press Start 2P at 14 to 16px — bitmap faces at text size collapse into noise, and the arcade-headline, grown-up-interface split is the whole thesis.
- Don't give the standard Ember Button a 0px radius to match the pixel art — square corners belong only to Pixel Buttons inside the 48px promo banner, and outside it they read as broken UI.
- Don't introduce a second accent such as #2473eb for links or icons — Cobalt Mark exists once, as the competitor's color, and any spread dilutes the one-hue budget.
- Don't use #f4352f for CTAs or sale badges — Cinder Alert means "not connected", and a red button would turn a privacy promise into a warning.
- Don't outline secondary buttons with a 1px #5c6066 border the way most SaaS kits do — Obscura demotes secondary actions to 600-weight text links, so Ember stays the single target.
- Don't loosen Jersey 10 line-height to a conventional 1.1 at 96px — at 0.7 the two lines lock together, and opening them up turns a headline into two captions.
- Don't place body copy in #989ea4 on #ffffff — Pewter Caption falls under 3:1 and should never carry more than an IP address or timestamp.

## Imagery

Imagery splits into three registers. The first is hand-built pixel art: a dungeon brick wall with a caged robot mascot, drifting 8-bit clouds, and a pixel-earth footer scene. The second is a high-fidelity macOS product screenshot showing the Location panel, with its own traffic lights and blue selection state; those colors are mockup-internal, not system tokens. The third is a founder photo. Pixel art is framed in a 48px-radius banner with no border. The product screenshot sits borderless on Sky Canvas under shadow lg and fades into the canvas at its lower edge. Editorial images take a 24px radius and a hard 24px offset shadow. Icons are 16px glyphs in #5c6066 for UI and 32px pixel pictograms in #ff5e24 for features. There are no gradient orbs, and the only translucency is the 12px glass blur. The narrative is a friendly game character escaping a surveillance dungeon into an open sky.

## Layout

Content holds a 1216px max-width for nav and hero copy, widening to 1536px for the feature grid and narrowing to 672px for centered paragraphs. Sections stack 96px apart on uninterrupted #dceefe, so there are no alternating bands. Rhythm comes from a white tile row, then glass panels, then centered Jersey headlines. The hero is a 48px-radius pixel promo banner, followed by a centered 96px two-line headline, a 16px subline, one 48px Ember Button and two ghost links, then a full-width app screenshot. The comparison is two columns, features are three-up, and there is no logo row. The 72px nav is sticky and filled #ffffff, with the wordmark and links left and Manage Account plus the CTA right, under a 32px status strip. The footer is a tall #6c3200 scene with 112px top padding. At 375px, drop display to 60px Jersey, section gaps to 64px and side padding to 16px. Overall density: spacious.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**
- canvas: #dceefe (Sky Canvas)
- card surface: #ffffff (Paper)
- headline text: #232629 (Graphite Ink)
- body text: #5c6066 (Slate Text)
- metadata text: #989ea4 (Pewter Caption)
- status: #f4352f (Cinder Alert)
- primary action: #ff5e24 (filled action)

**Color in Data**
Data views stay neutral (#ffffff tiles, #5c6066 and #989ea4 labels, fading opacity for depth), and #ff5e24 marks exactly one series or row — the Obscura side — as a 1px outline or text color rather than a solid bar fill, so the accent identifies rather than shouts.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Primary Action Button: Build an anchor reading "Try For Free" with a trailing 16px right-arrow icon and an 8px gap. Use background #ff5e24, text #ffffff, Manrope Variable 16px weight 600, line-height 24px, height 48px, padding 0 32px, border-radius 8px, no border. Apply box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.17), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.03), 0 0 0 1px #ff5e24, 0 1px 2px rgba(4,15,32,0.12), 0 4px 4px rgba(4,15,32,0.1), 0 8px 5px rgba(4,15,32,0.06), 0 15px 6px rgba(4,15,32,0.02). Center it below a headline with 32px top margin. For the nav variant, use height 36px, padding 8px 16px, 14px text, radius 6px, and the same shadow.

2. Hero section: On a #dceefe page, center a block at 1216px max-width with 96px top padding. Set an h1 in Jersey 10 at 96px weight 500, line-height 0.7, letter-spacing -2.4px. Line one, "Privacy that's", is #232629. Line two, "more than a promise", is #ff5e24. Below at 24px gap, add a Manrope Variable 16px weight 500 #5c6066 paragraph, max-width 672px, centered, with bold phrases at weight 700 #232629. Add the 48px Ember button 32px below. Under it at 24px gap, place two ghost links ("Use with Wireguard", "Other platforms") in Manrope 14px weight 600 #5c6066, each with a 16px icon, transparent background, padding 0 32px, radius 6px.

3. Navigation bar: Build a sticky bar 72px tall, background #ffffff, padding 0 64px, no border, box-shadow 0 5px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.03), 0 22px 22px rgba(0,0,0,0.03), 0 49px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.01), with inner content capped at 1216px. Left: a 103×22px wordmark in #232629, then links "Product", "Learn", "Pricing", "Discord" in Manrope 14px weight 500 #5c6066, padding 8px 16px, radius 6px, with chevrons on dropdowns. Right: "Manage Account" in 14px weight 600 #ff5e24, then the 36px Ember button with 6px radius. Above the bar, add a 32px #f6f8f7 strip with a centered 8px #f4352f dot (box-shadow 0 0 0 4px rgba(244,53,47,0.1)) and 12px weight 500 #f4352f text.

4. Glass comparison panel: Create two 496px columns with a 24px gap. Each panel has background #ffffff66, backdrop-filter blur(12px), border-radius 24px, padding 24px, and a 1px translucent white border, except the right panel, which takes a 1px #ff5e24 border. Each starts with a centered Manrope 16px weight 600 #232629 heading, with one key word in #2473eb on the left panel and #ff5e24 on the right. Inside, place a 16px-radius tile with a light grey fill and 8px padding containing white cards: background #ffffff, radius 12px, padding 16px, shadow 0 2px 4px rgba(15,34,52,0.04), 0 7px 7px rgba(15,34,52,0.04), 0 15px 9px rgba(15,34,52,0.02), 0 27px 11px rgba(15,34,52,0.01). Each card holds a 14px weight 600 #232629 name and a right-aligned 14px weight 500 #989ea4 IP. Cards fade to 50% opacity down the stack.

## Pixel Quarantine

The discipline is containment: bitmap type and pixel art are the brand's voice, but each is confined to a declared zone. Jersey 10 appears only at 36px and up. Press Start 2P appears only inside the 48px-radius promo banner. Square 0px corners and 4px bevels exist only on Pixel Buttons sitting on pixel artwork. Everything a user operates — nav, CTAs, cards, tags — is soft Manrope UI with 6 to 24px radii. Letting the pixel grammar leak breaks this: a 0px-radius nav button, Press Start 2P on feature titles, or bevel shadows on the 48px Ember Button. Each blurs the line between "game world" and "trustworthy tool". To extend the system, add new pixel scenes as framed illustrations at 24px or 48px radius, and add new headlines in Jersey 10. New controls, however playful the campaign, ship in Manrope with shadow md.

## One-Ember Rule

The chromatic budget is exactly one working hue. #ff5e24 has four permitted jobs: filled CTAs, the punchline half of headlines, single inline links or answers ("Not possible."), and outlines marking the Obscura side of a comparison. #f4352f is status, #2473eb is the competitor's single word, and the bevel pair #d54d1a and #ffc7b280 lives only inside pixel buttons. Breaking it is easy. Add a green "secure" badge, tint the feature icons in three colors, or fill a whole section with #ff5e24 — at 100% across a 1216px band, the orange stops being a signal and becomes wallpaper. Extend by assigning new emphasis to weight (700 #232629) or to a #ffffff tile on the sky, and spend Ember only where a reader should click or believe.

## Similar Brands

- **Mullvad VPN** — shares the anti-logging, account-number-only proposition and a single warm accent on calm surfaces, but sets everything in conventional sans with no game layer.
- **PostHog** — shares an orange accent and a retro, illustration-heavy voice on top of a serious technical product, though PostHog leans on desktop-OS nostalgia rather than 8-bit bitmap type.
- **Playdate by Panic** — shares the pixel-font display paired with a single saturated hue (yellow there) on otherwise neutral surfaces, with a toy-like confidence about a technical object.
- **Cloudflare WARP** — shares the orange-as-trust signal in privacy networking, but Cloudflare's enterprise grid lacks the sky canvas and the mascot narrative.
- **Tailscale** — shares a soft, light SaaS component kit with faint layered shadows and friendly illustration explaining network topology, minus the bitmap headline signature.
